description: Fixed category vocabulary for shopclass.json `categories` and external/<slug>.json `categories`. This is the enum source referenced by package.schema.json and external.schema.json.

categories.label: Payments
categories.description: Payment gateways, paid listing plans, and other monetization of the marketplace.

categories.label: Listings & moderation
categories.description: Listing lifecycle, review queues, flagging, and moderation workflow.

categories.label: Search
categories.description: Search relevance, filters, facets, and discovery of listings.

categories.label: Storage & media
categories.description: File storage, image/video processing, CDN offload, and media handling.

categories.label: SEO
categories.description: Search engine optimization: sitemaps, structured data, metadata, canonicals.

categories.label: Notifications
categories.description: Email, SMS, push, or webhook notifications to users and admins.

categories.label: Anti-spam
categories.description: Spam and abuse prevention: captcha, honeypots, submission filtering.

categories.label: Import & export
categories.description: Bulk import, export, feeds, and data migration in or out of a site.

categories.label: Integrations
categories.description: Connectors to external services and APIs: social login, analytics, CRMs, and similar.

categories.label: Admin tools
categories.description: Dashboard utilities, reporting, and other tools for site administrators.

categories.label: Localisation
categories.description: Languages, currencies, regions, and other locale-specific behaviour.

categories.label: Content & widgets
categories.description: Widgets, page templates, custom forms, and other content-authoring building blocks.
